notes: The supplied text (catalog pp. 81-83) is the 'Graduation and Transfer – Local AA/AS Degree General Education Requirements' section (areas L1-L7 for the local associate degree), not the Intersegmental GE Transfer Curriculum (IGETC) Certificate of Achievement section. No IGETC heading, area list, unit total or rule appears in the text, so no blocks were recorded for this award; the local GE areas were not substituted as IGETC requirements.
A reviewer should fetch the IGETC section of the 2026-2027 SCC catalog (likely on nearby pages) to record this certificate's areas and courses.

The local GE text prints renamed codes such as 'ENGL C1003 (formerly ENGWR 303)', 'ENGL 301 (formerly ENGWR 301)' and 'ENGL 488 (formerly ENGWR 488)', which correspond to closed-list ENGWR 303, ENGWR 301 and ENGWR 488.
No program outcomes or careers are printed in the supplied text.
